positions.name: MissingIdE2eTestRequirements
positions.frame: what must an end-to-end test for the missing-id failure pattern verify?
positions.why: Both expressions address the same end-to-end test for the missing-id failure pattern: src-1 asserts the test reproduces the production failure (a ## heading with no id field), while src-2 prescribes the required outcomes (no crash, valid slug). They share a technical, matter-of-fact register and parallel structure, cohering around the question of what the test must verify — even as conviction shifts from descriptive claim (src-1) to prescriptive decision (src-2).
